name: Sam's Club Deli Member's Mark Chicken Noodle Soup & Hawaiian Rolls
brandOrRestaurant: Sam's Club Deli & Bakery (Logan, South Jordan & Nationwide)
groceryIngredients: Member's Mark Rotisserie Chicken Noodle Soup
whyItWorks: Prepared deli tub of rotisserie chicken noodle soup paired with pillowy sweet Hawaiian rolls makes an effortless, gut-gentle meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Heat the soup on the stovetop and serve with warm Hawaiian rolls (avoid the pre-made Cranberry Pecan Chicken Salad which contains raw celery, dried cranberries, and pecans).
watchOuts: Do not confuse with the Deli Chicken Salad (which often contains celery and pecans)
